crossRefs.note: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned…
I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the…
who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of…
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel; because they had fallen by the sword.
translations.bsb: They mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the people of the LORD and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
translations.kjv: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
translations.asv: and they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Jehovah, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
